en.headline: Driver flees after police stop BMW in Wong Tai Sin; 90 etomidate capsules seized
en.dek: Traffic officers pursued the white car after it failed to give way at a zebra crossing; the driver abandoned the vehicle and escaped, police said.
body: Police seized about 90 capsules believed to contain etomidate after a white BMW failed to stop for officers in Wong Tai Sin on Wednesday and the driver fled.

The incident began around noon when the car did not give way at a zebra crossing near Fu Keung Street in Wang Tau Hom Estate. Kowloon East traffic officers followed and tried to stop the vehicle, but the driver accelerated and later abandoned the car near Fung Tak Road and Sheung Fung Street.

A sniffer dog assisted in the search. Police contacted the registered owner, who said he was overseas and had not lent the car to anyone. The case was classified as suspected drug trafficking and taking a conveyance without authority, with no arrests yet reported.

zh.headline: 黃大仙寶馬拒停司機逃去 警檢90粒依托咪酯
zh.dek: 交通警因車輛在斑馬線未讓路而追截，司機棄車逃走，警方其後在車上檢獲懷疑毒品。
body: 警方周三在黃大仙截查一輛白色寶馬私家車，司機拒絕合作後駕車逃走並棄車，警員在車上檢獲約90粒懷疑含有依托咪酯的膠囊。
事件約中午發生，車輛在橫頭磡富強街附近斑馬線未有讓路。九龍東交通警跟進並嘗試截停，但司機加速離開，其後在鳳德道及雙鳳街交界棄車逃走。
警方召來緝毒犬協助搜查，並聯絡登記車主，對方稱人在海外且沒有借出車輛。案件列作涉嫌販運危險藥物及未獲授權而取用運輸工具，暫未有人被捕。
